basic_info.description: Enjoy your urban retreat at The Lansing, Residence 108! This well-appointed 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath home boasts 1,090 SF of indoor-outdoor living, including a rare 377 SF private terrace, ideal for entertaining, dining al fresco, your furry kids, and gardening.  Inside, an open floor plan flows into a chef's kitchen with gas cooking, stainless steel appliances, and Studio Becker cabinetry. The spacious bedroom features two built-in closets, an ensuite bath, and room for a desk. A convenient half bath serves guests. In-unit laundry, deeded parking, and extra deeded storage round out this home. Nestled on the quieter side of Rincon Hill in South Beach, The Lansing offers a modern gym and a sprawling rooftop terrace with BBQ and breathtaking city views. Walk to work; and easy access to major freeways, public transit, and vibrant dining, shopping and entertainment near the Embarcadero, Oracle Park, and Chase Center.  Don't miss this exceptional value for your rich city experience!
